name: grid-start
listen: From the back of the grid, a stand to the left. Lamp tones at 1 s intervals over the field idling at 6000 rpm; lights out at 6 s: a 2 kHz tone, a cheer, the field revs to 11 500 rpm and pulls away, the cars sweep down in pitch as they leave and the far field takes over from the nearest six.

name: opponent-pass
listen: One car 4 m to the right closing at 50 m/s from 200 m ahead, passing at 4 s, gone 200 m behind: pitch from 527 Hz down to 393 Hz (firing frequency at 9000 rpm with Doppler), right of centre, darker once behind.

name: forest-leaving-stands
listen: Spa: leaving the start-straight stands for the forest. Crowd fades from both sides over 8 s; wind in the trees with slow gusts and bird calls remain.

name: city-night
listen: Singapore at night: low traffic rumble, floodlight hum at 100, 200 and 300 Hz, insects at 5 kHz in slow waves, a stand on the right.

name: menu-cues
listen: Menus: focus ticks, accept (rising), back (falling), focus, accept.
